--- Email Out ---
Subject: Project Report Submission Confirmation

Hi Dr. Nguyen,

I just submitted my final project report on Canvas but wanted to confirm that it uploaded correctly.

Best,
Brian

--- Email In ---
Subject: Re: Project Submission Confirmation

Hi Brian,

Yes, your report was received. I’ve attached the grading rubric for your reference before the presentation next week.

Regards,
Dr. Linh Nguyen

--- Attachment ---
Final Project Grading Rubric  
CS320 – Data Structures and Algorithms

Overview:  
This rubric outlines the criteria by which final project reports for CS320 will be evaluated. The report is expected to demonstrate a comprehensive understanding of data structures and algorithms, their application to a real-world or theoretical problem, and the ability to communicate findings effectively. Please review each section carefully to ensure your submission meets all
